memory.establishes: heap and texture MB measured before and after the walk's two weeks; flatness over a 30-day soak stays inferred

save_size.establishes: save size on the walk's mid-way save and at its end; growth over a longer soak stays inferred

mod_settings.establishes: every Scribe'd setting is mapped (scenes.json coverage_rest inv_settings_gate settings_map) to the scene control that turns it off or to T_SETTINGS_SWEEP_OFFLINE (default equals shipped, read by its mechanic, behind the Mod enabled master); the cross-biome switches ship off and labelled unsupported (T_SELF_CONTAINED_OFFLINE); a switch with no scene control has its off state checked statically only, which stays inferred
